verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents connecting card and finance platforms such as Brex and Ramp, and auto-categorizes the transactions that come in, which partly covers connecting credit-card accounts for automated transaction flow. The evidence never names direct bank-account feeds or a daily automatic import schedule. The reconciliation article only shows that bank and card accounts can be reconciled, not how their transactions get imported. Missing for 10: explicit bank-account connection/feeds, documented automatic daily import cadence, a list of supported banks and card issuers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day
